```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
#| label: dataset-glimpse

glimpse(penguins)
```

### Plot

Start with the penguins data frame, map bill depth to the x-axis and map bill length to the y-axis.

Represent each observation with a point and map species to the colour of each point.

Title the plot "Bill depth and length", add the subtitle "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins", label the x and y axes as "Bill depth (mm)" and "Bill length (mm)", respectively, label the legend "Species", and add a caption for the data source.

Finally, use a discrete colour scale that is designed to be perceived by viewers with common forms of colour blindness.

```{r}
#| label: initial-visualization
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_depth_mm, y = bill_length_mm, colour = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Bill depth and length", subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins", x = "Bill depth (mm)", y = "Bill length (mm)", color = "Species", caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/")
```

### Violin test

```{r}
#| label: violin
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, color = species, fill = species)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bill length and species", 
       subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
       caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/",
       dictionary = c(
         bill_length_mm = "Bill length (mm)",
         species = "Species"
  ))
```

```{r}
#| label: violin-color
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, color = species, fill = species)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bill length and species", 
       subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
       caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/",
       dictionary = c(
         bill_length_mm = "Bill length (mm)",
         species = "Species"
  )) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(
    name = waiver(),
    alpha = 1,
    begin = 0.1,
    end = 0.7,
    direction = 1,
    option = "B",
    aesthetics = "color"
  )  +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    name = waiver(),
    alpha = 1,
    begin = 0.3,
    end = 0.8,
    direction = 1,
    option = "B",
    aesthetics = "fill")
```

### Aesthetics

- color
- shape (stays the same in printing)
- size
- alpha


```{r}
#| label: aesthetics-test
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, 
       aes(x = bill_depth_mm, 
           y = bill_length_mm, 
           colour = species, 
           shape = species, 
           size = body_mass_g, 
           alpha = flipper_length_mm)) + # these are the mappings
  geom_point() + # these are settings
  labs(title = "Bill length, depth, flipper length, body mass and species", 
       subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
       caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/",
       dictionary = c(
         bill_length_mm = "Bill length (mm)",
         bill_depth_mm = "Bill depth (mm)",
         species = "Species",
         island = "Island",
         body_mass_g = "Body mass (g)",
         flipper_length_mm = "Flipper length (mm)"))
```

### Mapping vs. setting

**Mapping**: Determine the size, alpha, etc. of points based on the values of a variable in the data

goes into ``aes()``

**Setting**: Determine the size, alpha, etc. of points not based on the values of a variable in the data

goes into = ``geom_*()``

### Faceting

- Smaller plots that display different subsets of the data
- Useful for exploring conditional relationships and large data

```{r}
#| label: faceting-1
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, 
       aes(x = bill_depth_mm, y = bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(species ~ island) +
  labs(title = "Bill length, depth, island and species", 
       subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
       caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/",
       dictionary = c(
         bill_length_mm = "Bill length (mm)",
         bill_depth_mm = "Bill depth (mm)",
         species = "Species",
         island = "Island",
         body_mass_g = "Body mass (g)",
         flipper_length_mm = "Flipper length (mm)"))

```

```{r}
#| label: faceting-2
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, 
       aes(x = bill_depth_mm, y = bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(species ~ sex) +
  labs(title = "Bill length, depth, sex and species", 
       subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
       caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/",
       dictionary = c(
         bill_length_mm = "Bill length (mm)",
         bill_depth_mm = "Bill depth (mm)",
         species = "Species",
         island = "Island",
         body_mass_g = "Body mass (g)",
         flipper_length_mm = "Flipper length (mm)")) +
  guides(color = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#| label: faceting-3
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(penguins, 
       aes(x = bill_depth_mm, y = bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(sex ~ species) +
  labs(title = "Bill length, depth, sex and species", 
       subtitle = "Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
       caption = "Source: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) Penguin Data\n https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/",
       dictionary = c(
         bill_length_mm = "Bill length (mm)",
         bill_depth_mm = "Bill depth (mm)",
         species = "Species",
         island = "Island",
         body_mass_g = "Body mass (g)",
         flipper_length_mm = "Flipper length (mm)"))

```
